sources.snippet: Model Overview FinaPolat/Qwen3-8B-grounded_KGC-grpo-domains-coldstart is an 8 billion parameter language model built upon the Qwen3 architecture, offering a substantial context window of 32768 tokens. This model is engineered with a specific focus on knowledge graph completion (KGC) and grounded reasoning, making it particularly adept at tasks that require leveraging external knowledge sources.
